messages:
elaine_sales: Hey team — Acme POC kickoff today. Need a hosted API key for demo traffic (not production). Requirements: 14-day TTL, IP allowlist for their office CIDR 203.0.113.0/24, audit logs for all requests, and a clear rotation/removal plan. Can we provision and how fast?

mike_se: +1. Are they okay with a workspace-scoped key (can be revoked from console) or do they insist on a short-lived ephemeral key? Workspace-scoped is easier for demo dashboards.

elaine_sales: They said ephemeral is preferred but want us to avoid breaking the demo if we rotate mid-week. So: ephemeral with automated rotation + webhook notify to sales when revoked.

alice_security: For audit logs we can enable request-level logging for the key. Two questions: do we need to redact prompts in logs? And do we need legal-approved retention >90 days?

elaine_sales: Legal asked for 90 days retention but redaction is required for PII. For the POC prompts will be synthetic, but add redaction flag just in case.

jordan_eng: Implementation plan: create a scoped hosted API key with metadata: {owner: "elaine_sales", project: "acme-poc", ttl: 14d, ip_allowlist: ["203.0.113.0/24"], redact_logs: true, notify_on_revoke: "https://hooks.redwood.sales/acme-poc"}. We can automate rotation at day 7 to avoid expiry during demos.

mike_se: Quick caveat — workspace-scoped keys support allowlists and TTLs in the portal. Ephemeral keys require support-team invoker or the self-serve ephemeral flow (we have a UI button). If you want webhook on revoke, we need deploybot to emit the notification.

elaine_sales: Ok can ops create the key now and set rotation to 7 days? Demo tomorrow morning.

jordan_eng: I'll kick off provisioning. Command we use internally (for reference):

```
# internal CLI snippet (ops only)
redwoodctl keys create \
  --workspace acme-poc \
  --owner elaine_sales \
  --ttl 14d \
  --rotate-after 7d \
  --allowlist 203.0.113.0/24 \
  --redact-logs true \
  --notify-webhook https://hooks.redwood.sales/acme-poc
```

jordan_eng: deploybot: creating key now...

deploybot: Key created: key_ABC123xxxx (expires 2026-04-04T15:23:00Z). Rotation scheduled in 7 days. Audit logging: enabled, retention: 90d (redaction: enabled).

mike_se: Elaine — I'll DM the key to you via secure channel. Reminder: do not paste into customer chat. Use the demo host and the IP allowlist — if they test from a different network it will fail.

elaine_sales: Got it. Can we also add a simple revocation playbook in case they want us to turn off access after a failing security review?

alice_security: Revocation steps: 1) revoke key from portal (or CLI) 2) confirm webhook delivered and sales notified 3) confirm audit entry exists for revoke action 4) ask customer to rotate any stored local creds. I can draft a one-pager.

jordan_eng: Added a tiny automation: if legal flags the POC, a flagged tag will trigger immediate revoke and notify channel #sales with reason. Example revoke CLI: `redwoodctl keys revoke key_ABC123xxxx --reason "legal_blocker"`.

elaine_sales: Perfect — thanks team. Sending to Acme now. Will update here after the first demo. :thumbsup:
